description: This Java class defines an Akka Streams graph stage `DecisionByMetricStage` that processes lists of `StatusInfo` objects to decide whether to grant or reject cleanup credits based on metrics like maximum timer durations extracted from status info messages. It encapsulates logic for threshold-based credit decisions and involves multiple internal methods for analyzing status info data.

classes.name: DecisionByMetricStage
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create an Akka Streams decision stage for credits based on status info metrics.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a flow graph that processes lists of StatusInfo objects to produce CreditDecision objects based on a timerThreshold and credit per batch.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Decides whether to grant or reject credits based on maximum timer nanoseconds compared to a threshold.

methods.name: getMaxTimerNanos
methods.description: Calculates the maximum timer nanoseconds from a list of StatusInfo objects, returning either a left (negative decision) or right (max value).

methods.name: getMaxTimerNanosFromStatusInfo
methods.description: Extracts the maximum timer nanos from a single StatusInfo object; returns an Either indicating success (Right) with value or failure (Left) with reason.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Constructs an Either representing a negative CreditDecision with an explanatory message.
